title: The facts matter: Google updates AI Overviews, drawing more attention to linked sources
key_facts: Google announced on 15 Oct 2026 updates to AI Mode and AI Overviews.
Inline source links will appear higher in responses more frequently.
In AI Mode deeper dives show more prominent links with thumbnails.
A test: a "Quick results from the web" display with a short reason each link is a best source.
A prominent carousel of news stories for timely searches, tied to Preferred Sources.
Clickable creator and publisher profiles in video results, with a "Follow on Google" button.
quote_evidence: Google is moving its inline links "higher up in responses more frequently."
These updates to Google's Search AI will roll out throughout October
why_it_matters_hint: Makes the sources behind AI answers easier to see and check.
